app.name: CrossBorder Assist
app.description: Know what documents and official fees apply to your goods before you reach the border.

how.lead: Three answers in. One checklist out.

steps.body: We match your trip to rules from official sources.

steps.body: Documents, steps and fees, with a verdict.

about.title: About
about.lead: CrossBorder Assist helps small-scale traders see what they need before they cross.
about.does: Turns trade rules into a checklist for your goods, with a source on every item.
about.not: Not a customs office. It does not clear goods or take payments. Border officials make the final call.
about.where: An early version, starting with Kenya to Uganda. We are still testing it with traders.
about.who: A student team at Kisii University, as part of the SOEN 370 course.

items.a: No. Only to save a plan.
No. It is guidance. Border officials decide.

items.q: Where do the rules come from?
items.a: Official sources. Every item shows its source and check date.

items.q: What if you can't confirm something?
items.a: We say so, and point you to the Trade Information Desk at your crossing.
No. Our team sets a dated rate. Customs may use a different one.
Only the ones listed when you start a plan. Others are not covered yet.
